answer: Ask any master what his trade fears most and he will name the same thing: a man who can copy the mark but never learned the craft. Grocer spice tally with grocers attestation is the defence against that man: five-year tally, 2,000 stones weighed, pepper accounts, quarterly audit. Pass off work under a stolen zephyr and the work is condemned, the seller pays the buyer twice the price and the meadow is seized by the wardens, while the karst is entered in the book and shown to the next court.
